dedupe_keys.name: dataset for a critical evaluation of some constitutive models for finite element simulation of structural steel components

description: Dataset for A Critical Evaluation of Some Constitutive Models for Finite-Element Simulation of Structural Steel Components is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Machel Morrison, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). Contents of the dataset include experimental work on A992, its associated finite element simulation output and constitutive model parameter optimization results, and abbreviated Fortran code for a novel constitutive model used in the finite element simulations. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-gepe-4224. Keywords: Structural Steel  , Material Test, Component Test, A992, UMAT, Constitutive Model. Published 2024-12-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
